subject: [PATCH v2 2/4] selftests/mm: check sub-PMD ranges window by window in check_huge()

2026-10-09.patch_summary: This patch modifies the check_huge() function in selftests/mm to count aligned windows backed by a single folio of the requested order instead of counting all folios in the range. This change is made for orders below PMD and prepares the function for use in khugepaged.c. The patch moves the existing logic from is_range_backed_by_order() up into check_huge().
